### Gourmet Metabolism { #awakening-gourmet-metabolism }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/kuku/gourmet_metabolism.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Passive*

Everything the user eats heals them right away and the extra food turns into absorption hearts. While Gourmetamorphosis is active even items that are not food count as food.
